title: File:Heart shaped mount (FindID 460803).jpg
art: The Portable Antiquities Scheme, Patrick Brown, 2011-09-02 17:44:39
desc: A complete, cast copper-alloy, post medieval, mount (1550-1700). One end of the asymmetrical mount is heart shaped. The other, smaller end is in the form of two hollows with a central protruding leaf. One of the hollows has a piercing and the other looks like a piercing has not quite gone through. O
